section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the data analysis procedures for Study 4.1, including handling of missing data (using FIML and EM algorithm), manipulation checks via ANOVA, and overall effects via ANCOVA. The primary analysis employs a counterfactual mediation method to test whether post-test guilt mediates the effect of the manipulation (appearance vs. health frame; guilt vs. no guilt) on post-test body anxiety, while accounting for a potential treatment-mediator interaction. Covariates include trait body anxiety and post-test negative emotions.
